utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can bring a drill and some extra screws, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the pickup time and where everything’s going first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that makes sense — can you confirm the pickup time and where it’s headed?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I don’t have those details yet. Once I know the pickup time and destination, I can tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, anything you’ve got for repairs would help — screws, tape, maybe a screwdriver if you have one. I’m sorry, I’m a bit scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think I’ve got some tape and a few screws in the garage. I’ll bring what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’m still putting the details together, but I’ll let you know what’s needed when I get back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — just let me know when you’re back, and I’ll repeat the plan to whoever needs it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—you didn’t miss much. I’ve got the tools ready, and I can walk you through the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks. What time are we starting, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive — what time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re starting at 10 a.m. at the community shed, and just bring gloves, a water bottle, and any basic tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 10 with gloves, water, and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive this weekend. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you come by around 9 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help bridge the groups for the repair drive — who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the folks on Maple Street first — they’ve got the tools and usually respond quickly. Then loop in the community center so they can coordinate supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll start with Maple Street and then check in with the community center about supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara—could you help me track who needs what and bring it to the next block meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll start tracking who needs what and bring it to the next block meeting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and make a quick list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, Cleo—just keep it short and I’ll grab the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep it brief: I’ll check our supplies and send you a short list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Rey — I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of support already. I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first—what time does the repair drive start, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 9 a.m., and if you can, bring any tools or repair supplies you already have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll bring a drill and extra screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly I just need a bit of help moving the broken stuff over and keeping an eye on what gets dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. Just point me to where you want the broken stuff moved.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to swing by the repair drive and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — could you help gather volunteers and spread the word? I’m happy to send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — send me the details, and I’ll help gather volunteers and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I heard something about that. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not much yet—just trying to keep it going quietly. I’ll let you know if we need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks. Just give me a shout if there’s anything I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep things organized and make sure the repair drive is easy for everyone to join. Let’s figure out what needs attention first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’d start by listing the biggest issues and where they are, so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — I’ll start a simple list of the biggest issues and their locations, then we can sort them by urgency.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the exact time, place, and what kind of repairs we’re expecting first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact time, place, and repair details as soon as I have them. Thanks for being willing to help!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll wait for the details before I commit anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on—I’m just checking one detail before I confirm anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — can you confirm that detail soon?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—let’s keep it simple. Tell me what’s broken, and I’ll make a clear plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure which houses have been checked yet, but I can help figure out the next stop if you tell me where you’ve already been.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t checked any houses yet, so let’s start at the first one and work down the street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m just hearing bits and pieces, but I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be wonderful, Nell—thank you. We’re still short on a few supplies, so every bit of help counts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course—I’ll pass it along to anyone I hear from. If you get a list of the missing supplies, send it my way and I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m glad we’re kicking off the repair drive together, Cleo. Let’s make a simple list of needs and start coordinating volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll jot down the key needs and see who can help with each one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll ask around for anyone who can help with tools or a truck and we can compare notes soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—just tell me what time window you’re thinking.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning, maybe 9 to 11. If that works around school, I can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 11 should work for me around school. Go ahead and lock it in, and I’ll help spread the word.
